title: DroNc-seq
scope: Habib 2017 DroNc-seq implementation represented by the middle DroNC-Seq row of the supplied Illumina poster crop. The cell-suspension starting icon feeds nucleus isolation; only isolated nuclei enter droplets. The left single-nucleus/PolyA-RNA inset describes the target, not a parallel preparation. The neighboring snDrop-Seq and CITE-Seq rows are context, not target alternatives. Droplet bead recovery precedes RT, whereas the paper separately pools STAMPs across collections after RT. The extraction ends at sequencing reads; complete execution and downstream data analysis are outside the depicted architecture.
